lines.say: Nearly two hundred thousand people picked new Coke. Then came the calls.
By June, Coke's hotline took fifteen hundred calls a day, up from four hundred.
The test measured the sip. It missed the bond people had with the old Coke.
Seventy nine days in, the original came back. The hotline took thirty one thousand six hundred calls in two days.
caps: *79 days* in, the original came back.
